NBA DFS Picks for Thursday, November 5 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Thursday, November 5 · 2 games · First game 9:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 5, 9:29 AM ET

Giannis Antetokounmpo (MIA) is the top-projected player on the Thursday, November 5 DraftKings main slate at 55.8 DraftKings points for $11,000. Bam Adebayo (MIA, 43.8, $7,800) and Stephen Curry (GSW, 43.6, $8,200) are next.

Bam Adebayo (MIA) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.62 projected points per $1,000 at $7,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 5, 9:29 AM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
